# Action Network

> > Action Network is a progressive organizing platform providing advocacy organizations, nonprofits, and campaigns with tools for supporter engagement, fundraising, email campaigns, and mobile messaging.

Action Network serves as the digital infrastructure for progressive movements, enabling coalition building, corporate accountability campaigns, and community organizing. The platform is used by major organizations including Working America, Women's March Foundation, and Athena Coalition for political campaigns and advocacy work.

## Key Topics

- Community organizing
- Progressive activism
- Advocacy organizations
- Supporter engagement
- Fundraising tools
- Campaign management
- Nonprofit software
- Email campaigns
- Mobile messaging
- Political campaigns
- Coalition building
- Corporate accountability
- Grassroots organizing
- Voter engagement

## Platform Overview

- [Home - Action Network](https://actionnetwork.org/): Homepage: mobilize communities, fundraise & engage supporters with Action Network
- [Advocacy Organizations - Action Network](https://actionnetwork.org/advocacy-organizations/): Action Network tools for advocacy orgs to engage supporters & drive campaigns

## Updates & Resources

- [Action Network Blog – Updates from the Action Network team](https://actionnetwork.org/blog): Updates, partner spotlights & best practices from Action Network team

## Partner Organizations

- [Athena Coalition - Action Network](https://actionnetwork.org/groups/athena): Athena Coalition group page for Amazon accountability & workers' rights advocacy
- [National Union of Healthcare Workers (NUHW) - Action Network](https://actionnetwork.org/groups/nuhw): NUHW healthcare union advocacy for workers' rights & patient care
- [Voices United for Women - Action Network](https://actionnetwork.org/groups/voicesunitedforwomen): Voices United for Women Columbus, Ohio grassroots organizing group page
- [California High School Democrats - Action Network](https://actionnetwork.org/groups/cahsdems): California High School Democrats youth activism & voter registration group
- [Manchester Green Party - Action Network](https://actionnetwork.org/groups/manchestergreenparty): Manchester Green Party local politics & environmental justice group page

## Optional

- [Remove Scott Borsky from Cherry Hill & Voorhees PDs for Statements on Palestinians - Action Network](https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/scott_borsky): Petition to remove Scott Borsky from Cherry Hill & Voorhees police departments
